summary: Added a _QUOTED_IDENT regex that strips backtick-quoted identifiers from the objective before clause analysis in derive_routing, so trigger terms that appear only inside a quoted test name (e.g. `test_schema_migration_classifier`) do not cause specialist-domain escalation. Extended both parametrize lists in test_company_engineering_execution.py: two new 'routine' cases cover migration and authentication words in backtick-quoted identifiers, and one new 'breaking' case pins that a bare 'schema migration' in objective text still routes to architecture.
unresolved_risks: Only backtick-quoted identifiers are stripped; single- or double-quoted identifiers are not. If CEO objectives routinely use 'test_authentication_flow' (with ASCII quotes) those would still trigger falsely, but the acceptance criteria specify the quoted-test-identifier case which conventionally uses backticks.

The _QUOTED_IDENT regex matches any backtick-fenced span, not only identifiers. A backtick-quoted phrase that is genuine requested work (unlikely given CEO request conventions) would be silently dropped from routing.
